items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: and he says to Hymie Schertzer and myself, come on, we’ll go eat.

ctx.x: I heard Benny Goodman would never pick up the tab for lunch, is that true?

He did with me, but one time I said to Benny, “Hey I’m going to have to take you out next time.” He says, “You keep threatening.” No I got back at him. Oh we were playing the Fox Theater in Detroit, and he says, “Hey there’s a great restaurant down the street, it’s only about half a block down.” The Russian Bear, outside of the back stage of the Fox Theater in Detroit. So he says “Come on, Schneeze.” He called Arty Rollini “Schneeze” — big nose — and he says to Hymie Schertzer and myself, come on, we’ll go eat.…
